Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 26 · NFL Week 12 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 24, 11:38 PM ET

Josh Allen has the highest SPAGS projection in the Chiefs at Bills DraftKings Showdown: 20.8 points at $11,000 FLEX, 31.2 at captain for $16,500. In a game totaled at 47.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.2 times, and across 50,000 simulations he holds 68% of the winning-lineup credit.

Kenneth Walker III has the largest captain share: 17.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Walker at captain. The model gives him 16.5 carries and 3.9 targets. James Cook III is the next captain in line, at 16.6%. The model gives him 20.7 carries and 2.1 targets.

Buffalo is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 25.25 for the Bills and 22.25 for the Chiefs.

Behind Allen, Walker and Cook, the next projections are Patrick Mahomes (17.8, $10,000), Travis Kelce (11.8, $7,800) and Dalton Kincaid (11.2, $6,200).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 24, 11:38 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 50,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Kenneth Walker III, KC RB ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Kenneth Walker III holds 17.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $16,200 and the 19.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 28.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 16.5 carries and 3.9 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Walker averaged 19.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 35.8. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.4% as the captain and 39.2% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: James Cook III, BUF RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

James Cook III holds 16.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 18.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 20.7 carries and 2.1 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Cook averaged 18.0 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 35.6. He holds 56% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.6% as the captain and 39.1% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Josh Allen holds 16.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 20.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 31.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.2 rushing attempts. Across 50,000 simulations Allen averaged 20.8 points with a simulated floor of 13.0 and a ceiling of 39.4. He holds 68% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.4% as the captain and 51.8% in a FLEX spot.

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,000 FLEX and $16,500 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.
